review_method: Read all 30 local discovery records. Directly reviewed the pinned source README/package/implementation or CI files for Ducksss/payload-components, jal-co/scn-stack, vantezzen/shadcn-registry-template, rebeccarich/storybook-addon-flow-builder, troychaplin/component2block, and olivercaine/ui-component-library. No candidate was treated as admitted from discovery metadata or repository claims.

candidates.description: A Shadcn-inspired component registry for Rust. Build cross-platform apps for Web, Desktop, iOS and Android.
candidates.reason: The local record describes a Rust cross-platform registry, not a Next.js/React block. Target adaptation, pinned source provenance, dependency/asset clearance, build, browser smoke, owner, and rollback evidence are absent.

candidates.description: Servercn , the backend component registry for Node.js inspired by shadcn/ui. The shadcn philosophy for Node.js backend.
candidates.reason: The record is a Node.js backend registry, not a UI block or read-only Postgres adapter. No Horizon-compatible component source, contract, browser surface, or admission receipt is identified.

candidates.description: The mono repo that builds the homepage, utils, ui components, registry and anything else
candidates.reason: The discovery record identifies a broad monorepo with a registry but no bounded component item or target install contract. A candidate item, pinned commit, dependency/asset scan, build, browser smoke, ownership, and rollback proof remain unprovided.

candidates.description: Experimenting with AI our way into the unknown — monorepo: agentx (agentic code generation engine) + shadxn (component registry & transforms)
candidates.reason: The local record reports no license and combines an agentic generation engine with registry transforms. License/provenance, generated-source ownership, dependency/asset review, and target build/browser evidence are unresolved.

candidates.description: waveshare componets For ESP Component Registry
candidates.reason: The record is an ESP32 hardware component registry. Apache-2.0 alone does not resolve the platform mismatch or prove a reusable web block, browser smoke, or rollback contract.

candidates.description: Component registry for Dioxus, inspired by shadcn.
candidates.reason: The record describes a Dioxus/Rust registry rather than a React/Next block. No source conversion, target dependency proof, browser smoke, ownership, or rollback evidence exists in the local record.

candidates.description: Open-source documentation and public component registry for unlumen UI
candidates.reason: The record identifies a public documentation/registry surface but not a bounded Horizon-compatible item. Pinned item provenance, dependency/asset clearance, build, browser smoke, owner, and rollback receipts are missing.

candidates.description: Template repository for building a custom component registry for shadcn/ui
candidates.reason: Direct source review shows a useful shadcn registry template with generated JSON, dependencies, CSS variables, and a Pages workflow, but the pinned source has no LICENSE file and the bundled demo uses a deprecated marquee element. It cannot pass the license or production adaptation gate.

candidates.description: Payload Components: registry-backed Payload CMS blocks installed wired, not pasted.
candidates.reason: Direct source review confirms an MIT LICENSE, registry:block items, manifests, a provenance ledger, dry-run/idempotent install claims, and CI release/fresh-consumer/visual gates. It is Payload-specific rather than a ready Horizon block, and no local checkout, dependency/asset scan, build, browser smoke, screenshot, owner, or rollback receipt was executed. Upstream adapted-source provenance also needs independent verification.
